why_math: Uncertainty measured by curiosity score reveals exactly when and what external knowledge helps; targeted retrieval beats pre-loading all facts.

math_plain: The system predicts future events by analyzing temporal trends and finding latent connections within time windows, then corrects errors.
why_math: Real events follow causal chains through time and hidden correlations; checking predictions against logic catches hallucinations.

math_plain: Items are ranked by balancing multiple goals across sequential recommendation screens, resolving conflicts between conversion, views, and engagement.
why_math: User behavior under immersive swiping has hidden trade-offs; ranking on all signals together prevents short-sighted picks that hurt overall experience.

why_math: Decomposing class features into common building blocks decouples sharing from class count; personalization works because blocks combine differently per device.

math_plain: A small controller learns how the graph environment is changing and generates custom parameters to adapt without retraining.
why_math: Change happens in hidden patterns; a compact state space tracking these patterns lets you adapt instantly by only tweaking parameters, not rebuilding.

math_plain: User and location embeddings are learned so that similar users and their actual locations sit close together in a learned space.
why_math: Closeness in a learned space only works if users who match similar posts end up nearby; the loss enforces this by penalizing dissimilar pairs.

math_plain: The model learns user preferences from long behavior sequences in segments, using future behavior as a reward signal to stay accurate.
why_math: Future actions prove whether inferred preferences were correct; rewarding predictions that forecast the next segment prevents hallucinated preferences.
